report:
The three neighbors are close to a workable plan, but everything now waits on A's dates. A has twice said she will check her calendar and send a first and second choice of weekend, and has not yet done so. C has agreed to pick a separate turn in the same few-week window as soon as A's options arrive. B has agreed to ask her landlord whether the trailer can stay on the pad or be moved, and to report back, though she cannot promise how quickly he will answer. A and C have both said plainly they will not wait for the other to finish, and both want separate, definite turns with dates fixed in advance.

Current list of concerns
1. A and C both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither will back down. Raised by C.
2. The trailer lives on B's pad, so B is caught in the middle. Raised by C.
3. B would like a plan for getting the trailer off her pad, but feels awkward pressing for it because she agreed to keep it there. Raised by B.
4. B rents, and her landlord must approve any change to what is kept on the pad. B has not asked him yet. Raised by B.
5. B wants to know who will check with the landlord and where the trailer could go. Raised by B.
6. C needs the trailer within the next few weeks for hauling on a home project, and will not wait until A is done. Raised by C.
7. C needs a definite turn soon, and says he cannot decide A's or B's part. Raised by C.
8. A wants the trailer for weekend trips in the next few weeks. Raised by A.
9. A's plan needs agreed dates, and use without renegotiating each time. Raised by A.
10. B can ask her landlord, but cannot promise what he will approve or how quickly. Raised by B.
11. B would like A and C to look into another place for the trailer. Raised by B.
12. A will not agree to wait until C is done, and wants specific, separate dates picked now so each person has a definite turn. Raised by A.
13. B has agreed to ask her landlord and will report back, but is unsure how quickly he will reply. Raised by B.
14. A has not pinned down exact weekends yet and will send options from her calendar. Raised by A.
15. C cannot narrow his timing beyond the next few weeks, and says dates can be picked once A's weekends are in. Raised by C.

I made no legal decisions and moved no money. Open items: A's two weekend options, C's pick of a separate turn once those arrive, B's word from her landlord, and whether A and C can find another place to keep the trailer.
